dependencies.description: The dependencies for the plan. This is "Sequential" or "Concurrent".

endDate.description: The end date field for the plan.

estimation.description: The estimation unit for the plan. This is "StoryPoints", "Days" or "Hours".

inferredDates.description: The inferred dates for the plan. This is "None", "SprintDates" or "ReleaseDates".

startDate.description: The start date field for the plan.
